My dear [Mr Warden](/person/1304),[^2]
I find I cannot well leave home till the 3.30 train on Wednesday, so I hope to be at Oxford at 6.45. I hope this is not so late as to put out your dinner hour as I think it often is at 7.30. I am very glad to hear that [Mr Wither](/person/1544) will be there
Yours very sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: With envelope addressed to \'The Revd the Warden/ New College/ Oxford\', postmarked Winchester and Oxford 21 and 22 April 1873.
[^2]: The Rev.

James Edwards Sewell, Warden of New College, Oxford and brother of Elizabeth Sewell.
